blocks.raw: > Akamai's Direct Connect is a high performance network interconnection between your origin infrastructure and the Akamai Intelligent Edge Platform. Direct Connect lets you connect to the platform without using a third-party IP transit provider. It provides private connectivity between the platform and a router in your data center or colocation environment.
blocks.text: Akamai's Direct Connect is a high performance network interconnection between your origin infrastructure and the Akamai Intelligent Edge Platform. It provides private connectivity between the platform and a router in your data center or colocation environment.
